subject: NeedlePoint: usage profile, target $/1M tokens & incentive path
messages:
From: Pete Moran <pete.moran@needlepoint.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: NeedlePoint discovery notes — token profile & discount asks

Hi Lauren / Aditya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Sana and I appreciated the demo and the breakdown of Redwood's dedicated vs hosted options. I wanted to capture a few items from our side and ask for some concrete ranges so we can align with finance.

Quick recap of NeedlePoint's expected profile (rough numbers):
- Active users: 18k monthly (chat + summarization flows)
- Typical prompt+response avg: ~1.3k tokens/session (heavy context + multi-turn)
- Calls per user/month: ~12
- Expected short-term volume (Q4): ~200M tokens/month; long-term target (12mo): 1.2B tokens/month if we scale as projected

Finance asked for a target budget envelope expressed as $/1M tokens and confirmation of whether startup credits can stack with volume/commit discounts. Specific asks from our side: 
1) What is a realistic target $/1M tokens at starter volumes (200M/month) vs committed 12mo (1.2B/month)?
2) If we sign a 12-month committed-use agreement, what % discount bands apply and at what commitment levels?
3) Is NeedlePoint eligible for Redwood's startup program (we're still pre-Series A, raised a small seed) and if so, can startup credits be combined with committed discounts?
4) Do you offer reserved slot guarantees or burst buffers for enterprise spikes (we have periodic batch ingest jobs that spike traffic) — any impact to unit economics?

I've attached a very rough forecast (needlepoint-forecast-q4.xlsx). Can you point us to the fastest path to a pilot + formal quote?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call tomorrow morning PT if needed.

—Pete
Pete Moran
Head of Platform, NeedlePoint
http://needlepoint.ai

Attachment: needlepoint-forecast-q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeedlePoint discovery notes — token profile & discount asks

Pete — thanks for the clear summary and the forecast. Great to meet you and Sana on the call. Below is a short post-call recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Recap (from Redwood's side)
- Best match: Hosted API to start (fastest to pilot), with option to move to Dedicated or Private for year-1 committed volumes.
- Key levers for unit economics: batching, KV-prefix caching, sequence-length optimization, and commitment tiering.

Answers / notes on your asks
1) Target $/1M tokens (starter vs committed): I'll have Ben (pricing) share scenario bands, but as a reference we typically see effective unit prices vary widely depending on average seq length and batching — I'll include three scenarios (starter, 12mo committed, multi-year).
2) Committed-use % bands: Ben will propose bands and the commitment thresholds we recommend for predictable latency + pricing.
3) Startup program stacking: Short answer — possible, but limited. We need to qualify NeedlePoint for the program; some early credits can be applied, but core discounts for committed use are typically applied post-credit and some manual approval required for stacking.
4) Reserved slots / burst: Yes, we offer configurable burst capacity on Dedicated with an SLA; bursting affects the billing profile (you pay for reserved vs burst at different rates) — Ben to include an example.

Next steps (proposed)
- Ben: Share three pricing scenarios and explicit $/1M token numbers (by 09/15 EOD PT).
- Redwood/NP: Confirm startup program eligibility form + legal (I'll send qualification link).
- Schedule 30m follow-up to review pricing and pilot scope (suggest Thu 09/16 10:00–10:30 PT).

Attaching our startup program overview while we qualify you (redwood-startup-program-overview.pdf).

If that looks good, Ben — over to you.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.inference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com, Pete Moran <pete.moran@needlepoint.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NeedlePoint discovery notes — token profile & discount asks

Lauren / Pete — thanks, pinging with three scenario bands and the assumptions behind the $/1M numbers so we can be explicit. These are conservative working numbers for initial negotiation and will be refined once we validate actual runtime characteristics during the pilot.

Assumptions (summary):
- Avg tokens/session: 1,300 (as provided)
- Effective batch factor (after client batching + runtime): 1.4x for chat, 2.0x for summarization — blended 1.6x assumed
- KV cache reuse: medium (30% reuse on repeated prompts)
- Sequence length distribution pushes compute up ~25% vs baseline; all economics below reflect that uplift

Scenario A — Starter (no commit; hosted)
- Sticker: $3,200 per 1M tokens (effective)
- Notes: higher due to no reservation, full pay-as-you-go and premium for burst protection

Scenario B — 12-month commit (1.2B tokens/month target; monthly invoiced, annual term)
- Suggested commitment band: >= 8B tokens committed over 12 months (≈1.2B/mo)
- Discount: 35% off sticker -> Effective ~$2,080 per 1M tokens
- Add-on: burst buffer available; burst usage billed at starter rate above reserved baseline

Scenario C — Multi-year (2-yr) + heavier commit
- Suggested: 20% uplift in committed volume (reserve 9.6B/yr) + 2-yr term
- Discount: 45% off sticker -> Effective ~$1,760 per 1M tokens

Startup program stacking guidance
- Eligibility: Seed-stage startups generally qualify for a one-time credit package; credits reduce first invoices but do not directly change the contractual committed unit-rate.
- Stacking: We can apply a startup credit on top of a committed pricing schedule in many cases, but discount stacking beyond ~15% total additional manual approval is rare. For NeedlePoint, we can propose: startup credit (one-time) + standard committed discount (35%) as long as legal approves combining incentives.

Pilot recommendation
- 6-week pilot on Hosted with traffic routing to validate seq lengths and batching opportunities. Pilot run captures token burn and a recommended Dedicated reservation if you want predictable unit economics for Q4.

Deliverables and timeline
- Formal PDF quote with line items and commitment language (Ben) — sending by 2026-09-15 EOD PT. (attachment: pricing-scenarios-needlepoint.pdf)
- Qualify NeedlePoint for startup package (Lauren to send qualification link).
- Schedule Thu 09/16 10:00 PT to review quote.

If Pete/Sana want, I can also include an optional modeling sheet that converts their monthly traffic into expected invoice lines under each scenario.

—Ben Carter
Director, Cloud Sales — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: pricing-scenarios-needlepoint.pdf (proposal)

Ben / Lauren — this is super helpful, thank you. A few quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you send the formal quote with explicit line items for Reserved vs Burst and a worked example for 200M/month entry?
2) We are Seed-stage and would like to push for the startup credits + the 35% commit discount; what exact docs do you need from us to qualify (cap table / investor intro / company website)?
3) On reserved capacity: can we reserve a small dedicated pool for Q4 with the option to convert to larger Dedicated capacity mid-term? How does that change the unit rates?

We're happy to accept the Thu 09/16 10:00 PT slot to review the proposal. I'll bring our finance lead so we can move quickly on an LOI if the numbers line up. Attaching a signed MOA that confirms intent to move to pilot (signed-moa.pdf).
